_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Tha thu a' cluich Klondike Solitaire. Am miann agad gus gluasad a h-uile cairt gu na cruachan bunaiteach.

Riaghailtean a' Gheama:
- Cruachan bunaiteach (F1-F4): Tog suas bho Ace gu Rìgh ann an dath
- Cruachan clàr (T1-T7): Tog sìos a' ghluasad dathan (dearg air dubh, dubh air dearg)
- Stoc: Tarraing cairtean gu mòr-chosg
- Mòr-chosg (W): Cairt bhàrr airson cluich

Àithnean:
- 'draw' - Tarraing cairtean bho stoc gu mòr-chosg
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Gluais cairtean eadar cruachan
  Eisimpleirean: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. Faodaidh count cuideachd a bhith 'all', a dh'fheuchas gluasad a h-uile cairt a tha a' coimhead suas.
- 'forfeit' - Crìochnaich a' gheama gu luath agus glas a' sgòr làithreach agad
- Ainmean cruachan: W (mòr-chosg), F1-F4 (bunaiteach), T1-T7 (clàr)

Faodaidh tu gnìomhan ioma a dh'fhàgail ann an aon turas le bhith gan dealachadh le commaichean:
  Eisimpleir: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Cha ghabh càird a chur air cruachan clàr falamh ach Rìgh.
Gnìomhan a' dol an òrdugh - mura h-eilear aon, thèid na gnìomhan eile a leigeil seachad.
Cleachd 'forfeit' ma tha thu a' smaointinn gu bheil a' gheama do-dh'fhàgail.
